dataset: Buildings of local importance / Exeter Local List access page
license: License not stated on the selected source page
evidence_slice: Exeter City Council's official Buildings of local importance page states that the adopted Exeter Local Plan First Review identifies non-designated heritage assets of local importance, commonly called the Local List. It states that selected structures may be exemplars of distinctive or special building types and styles and links the Local List in Schedule 5 pages 100-106. The selected HTML source window does not publish record-level polygon coordinates or a downloadable geometry payload for any individual building.

field_evidence.footprint: No record-level polygon coordinates or downloadable building geometry are published in the selected HTML source window.
field_evidence.type_use: The official page states Local List structures can be exemplars of distinctive or special building types/styles and may be associated with locally distinctive activities, events, personalities and communities.
field_evidence.source_scope: The page identifies Exeter's non-designated heritage assets of local importance and points to the Local Plan First Review Schedule 5 Local List.
